form.title: Butterworth Heritage & Wildlife Discovery – Full Day Tour
form.destinationArea: Butterworth, Seberang Jaya & Teluk Air Tawar
form.shortDescription: Explore mainland Penang's hidden gems with colourful street art, fascinating birds, cultural landmarks and relaxing coastal views on a memorable full-day adventure.
form.fullDescription:
Discover the hidden treasures of mainland Penang with our Butterworth Heritage & Wildlife Discovery – Full Day Tour, a memorable journey combining wildlife, local heritage, cultural landmarks and coastal scenery.

Begin your adventure at Penang Bird Park in Seberang Jaya, where you can discover fascinating bird species, explore tropical garden environments and experience educational wildlife exhibits.

After enjoying a delicious local lunch, continue to Butterworth Art Walk, a colourful outdoor gallery showcasing murals inspired by the history, culture and traditional lifestyles of Seberang Perai.

Explore the impressive architecture of Tow Boo Kong Temple, one of Butterworth's significant cultural landmarks, and learn about the area's Chinese heritage and traditions.

Complete your journey with a relaxing visit to Robina Eco Park in Teluk Air Tawar. Enjoy refreshing sea breezes, coastal scenery and beautiful views across the Penang Strait.

With convenient ground transportation, selected attraction admission, local lunch and guided sightseeing, this package is perfect for families, students, couples and travellers seeking to experience a different side of Penang beyond the island's popular tourist attractions.
form.taxNotes: Penang Bird Park currently publishes standard admission rates of RM65 for adults and RM45 for children below 12, with separate MyKad/MyKid rates. The suggested package prices are higher to account for transport, food and guide services, but they are not supplier quotations.
form.meetingPoint: Level 2, near the Taxi Pick-Up & Drop-Off waiting area, Penang Sentral, Jalan Bagan Dalam, 12100 Butterworth, Penang.
form.departureNotes:
Travellers must arrive at Penang Sentral by 8:45 AM for registration and a short tour briefing.

The guided excursion is scheduled to depart at 9:00 AM from the designated pickup area at Penang Sentral, Butterworth.

All participants must present their TravelMate booking voucher and a valid identification document during registration.

The tour escort will verify traveller details, explain the daily itinerary and provide essential safety instructions.

Travellers are advised to wear comfortable walking shoes, bring sufficient drinking water and prepare appropriate sun protection.

The tour is expected to conclude at approximately 5:00 PM at Penang Sentral.

Departure and return times may vary depending on weather, local traffic conditions and attraction operating schedules.

Travellers who expect to arrive late should contact the assigned tour operator before departure.
form.highlights:
Discover fascinating birds and tropical wildlife at Penang Bird Park.
Explore colourful heritage murals along Butterworth Art Walk.
Admire the impressive architecture of Tow Boo Kong Temple.
Enjoy a delicious local Malaysian lunch in Seberang Jaya.
Relax by the coastline and enjoy scenic views at Robina Eco Park.
form.inclusions:
Standard admission ticket to Penang Bird Park, including access to visitor exhibits and aviaries.
Guided sightseeing experience at Butterworth Art Walk.
Cultural visit to Tow Boo Kong Temple.
Coastal sightseeing experience at Robina Eco Park.
One local Malaysian lunch at a selected dining venue.
Private air-conditioned ground transportation throughout the scheduled excursion.
English-speaking tour escort providing guided introductions to local heritage, cultural landmarks, and attractions.
Designated pickup and return drop-off at Penang Sentral, Butterworth.
Driver services, fuel, and road tolls for scheduled transfers.
form.transportTypes:
Private air-conditioned MPV or minibus
Guided walking tour at Butterworth Art Walk
Walking exploration at Penang Bird Park
Short guided cultural walk at Tow Boo Kong Temple
Leisure walking at Robina Eco Park
form.accommodationNotes:
This is a single-day sightseeing excursion and does not include overnight accommodation.

Travellers are not required to arrange hotel check-in or check-out as part of the package.

The tour begins at approximately 9:00 AM and concludes at approximately 5:00 PM on the same day.

Private air-conditioned transportation is provided for all scheduled transfers between attractions.

The tour starts and ends at Penang Sentral, Butterworth.

Travellers requiring overnight accommodation before or after the excursion must arrange their own lodging.

Personal hotel expenses and additional transfers outside the scheduled itinerary are not included.
form.exclusions:
Domestic and international flights to Penang.
Hotel accommodation and overnight stays.
Breakfast and dinner.
Transportation to Penang Sentral before the tour and from Penang Sentral after the tour.
Personal travel and medical insurance.
Personal shopping, souvenirs, snacks, and additional beverages.
Optional bird-feeding activities where separately charged.
Additional attraction admission fees not specified in the itinerary.
Personal donations or purchases at religious sites.
Ferry tickets and transportation outside the scheduled itinerary.
Personal expenses and services not expressly included in the package.

form.cancellationPolicy:
Travellers may cancel their bookings before the scheduled departure date, subject to the following conditions:

7 days or more before departure: 100% refund of the eligible package payment.

3 to 6 days before departure: 50% refund of the eligible package payment.

Less than 3 days before departure: No refund.

No-show on departure day: No refund.

Cancellation requests must be submitted through the designated TravelMate support channel or directly to the assigned tour operator.

The cancellation period is calculated according to Malaysian local time (GMT+8).

Approved cancellations are subject to verification of the booking and applicable payment records.
form.refundPolicy:
If the tour is cancelled by the operator due to insufficient participants, attraction closures, safety concerns or unforeseen operational circumstances, travellers will be offered a full refund or an alternative departure date.

If severe weather makes an outdoor activity unsafe, the operator may adjust the itinerary, reschedule the affected activity or provide a suitable alternative.

Where a substantial portion of the purchased package cannot be delivered, the operator will assess the appropriate refund or alternative arrangement.

Approved refunds will be returned through the original payment method where supported. Actual processing times depend on the payment provider and relevant financial institutions.

For TravelMate FYP demonstration transactions using Stripe Test Mode, no real payment is collected and no real monetary refund is issued.

Actual commercial refund arrangements must comply with applicable booking terms and consumer protection requirements.
form.bookingTerms:
Bookings must be submitted at least 72 hours before the scheduled departure.

Each tour requires a minimum of 4 travellers and accommodates a maximum of 8 travellers.

Adult pricing applies to travellers aged 12 years and above. Child pricing applies to travellers aged 3 to 11 years. Children below 3 years old require advance arrangements.

All children must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

Travellers must provide accurate booking information and attend registration at the designated meeting point.

A TravelMate booking voucher or confirmation record will be issued through the applicable booking workflow once booking requirements are satisfied.

Travellers are required to present their booking voucher and a valid identification document before boarding the tour vehicle.

Tour participation remains subject to operator confirmation and sufficient group numbers.

FYP demonstration vouchers and sandbox payment records do not represent valid commercial attraction reservations.
form.importantNotes:
This tour is suitable for participants with a basic to moderate level of physical fitness.

Activities involve walking through outdoor attractions, cultural sites, bird park pathways and coastal recreational areas.

Some locations may feature uneven walking surfaces, steps, slopes or limited wheelchair accessibility.

Travellers are advised to wear comfortable footwear and remain hydrated throughout the excursion.

The tropical climate of Penang may involve high temperatures, humidity, occasional heavy rain and exposure to insects.

Visitors must follow attraction safety rules and avoid touching or feeding animals unless expressly permitted by attraction staff.

Appropriate and respectful clothing is recommended when visiting religious sites.

Parents or guardians must supervise accompanying children throughout the tour.

Travellers with mobility limitations, medical conditions, allergies or special assistance requirements should contact the operator before booking.

Full wheelchair accessibility cannot be guaranteed for every activity.
form.transportNotes:
Private air-conditioned transportation will be provided using an MPV or minibus suitable for the confirmed group size.

As this is a single-day excursion, travellers are encouraged to bring only a small daypack and essential personal belongings.

Large suitcases, oversized luggage and bulky equipment are not recommended due to limited vehicle storage space.

All passengers must wear seat belts where fitted and comply with the driver's safety instructions.

Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside the tour vehicle.

Travellers must keep their valuables, identification documents and personal belongings secure throughout the journey.

Scheduled transportation includes transfers between Penang Sentral and all attractions listed in the itinerary.

Additional private transfers and unscheduled transportation requests are not included.

Travel times may change depending on traffic congestion, road conditions and weather.
itineraryTitle: Butterworth Wildlife, Cultural Heritage & Coastal Discovery
itineraryAccommodation: None – Single-Day Tour Without Overnight Accommodation
itineraryDescription:
Begin your mainland Penang adventure at 8:45 AM with registration and a short briefing at Penang Sentral, Butterworth.

Depart at 9:00 AM in a private air-conditioned vehicle and travel towards Seberang Jaya.

At approximately 9:30 AM, arrive at Penang Bird Park, a family-oriented wildlife attraction featuring tropical gardens, walk-in aviaries and diverse bird species. Enjoy a relaxing exploration of the park and learn about the fascinating characteristics of local and exotic birds. Subject to availability, observe the scheduled bird show at approximately 11:30 AM.

At noon, complete the park visit and proceed to a selected restaurant in Seberang Jaya for an included Malaysian lunch.

After lunch, travel to Butterworth Art Walk, where colourful outdoor murals illustrate the history, traditional trades and cultural development of mainland Penang. Enjoy a guided stroll and opportunities for photography.

Continue to Tow Boo Kong Temple along Jalan Raja Uda at approximately 2:35 PM. Discover the temple's impressive traditional architecture and cultural significance while exploring permitted public areas.

In the late afternoon, travel to Robina Eco Park in Teluk Air Tawar. Enjoy a relaxing coastal walk, refreshing sea breezes and scenic views across the Penang Strait.

At approximately 4:30 PM, depart the coastal park and return to Penang Sentral.

The tour concludes at approximately 5:00 PM, marking the end of an enjoyable day exploring Butterworth's wildlife, heritage and coastal attractions.

itineraryMeals: Lunch – Local Malaysian set meal at a selected restaurant in Seberang Jaya.
itineraryTransportNotes: Private air-conditioned MPV or minibus transportation is provided throughout the full-day excursion.  Route: Penang Sentral → Penang Bird Park → Seberang Jaya Lunch Venue → Butterworth Art Walk → Tow Boo Kong Temple → Robina Eco Park → Penang Sentral.  Driver services, fuel and road tolls for all scheduled transfers are included.  Travellers should arrive at the meeting location at least 15 minutes before departure.  Travel times are estimates and may vary depending on local traffic, weather conditions and attraction schedules.  The final return transfer is expected to arrive at Penang Sentral by approximately 5:00 PM.
